Name: Wild Tree Framework
Author: MoorTarPetal
TagLine: Extensions to wild trees to open them up for custom wild trees
Description:
More options available for custom-made wild trees!:

Random spawns:
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.SpawnOnFarm": (true, false) : Allows tree to spawn on farm
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.SpawnChance": (0.0 - 1.0) : Chance of success when tree is randomly chosen to be
spawn  (Default: 0.01)
﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.SpawnFromWeeds" (true / false) : Enable to restrict spawns around weeds and debris 
(Default: true)

WldSpawns:
﻿DATA/LOCATION CONTEXTS:
﻿﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.WildTreeIds" (e.g. "Id01, Id02") : Used to control the trees that are allowed to
spawn in maps with this location context
DATA/LOCATIONS: ﻿
﻿﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.EnableSpawns" (true / false) : Whether this location allows  tree spawns  (Default: false)
﻿﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.SpawnAreas (e.g. "65, 7, 66, 8") : specify multiple area that the tree can
spawn (topRightTile.X, topRightTile.Y, bottomLeftTile.X, bottomLeftTile.Y, ... )
﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.WildTreeIds" (e.g. "Id01, Id02") : Used to control the trees that are allowed to
spawn in maps with this location context . Each location by default is given the Id "SpawnId_[LocationName] (e.g. SpawnId_Beach)
﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.WildTreeIds" (e.g. "Id01, Id02") : Used to control the trees that are allowed to
spawn in maps with this location context - Will override location context Ids (Required)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.NoAdditionalChecks" (true, false) : Loosen restrictions on tree spawn location (Default: false)
﻿
DATA/WILDTREES: ﻿
﻿﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.WildSpawnIds" (e.g. "Id01, Id02") : The places this tree can spawn (Default: false)
﻿﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.SpawnChance.X" (0.0 - 1.0) : The chance of the tree spawning in location contexts with
the specified Id, otherwise the tree's default spawn chance is used. (Default: 0.01)
﻿﻿"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.IncludeWinter" (true, false) : Whether this tee will spawn in winter (Default: false)

﻿
 
Fence Destruction:
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FenceChance (0.0 - 1.0) : Chance of tree destroying fences (on windy days  (Required)

Fruit Spawns (up to 5)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FruitId.1" (e.g. "309") : What fruit spawns on the ground (Required)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FruitChance.1": (0.0 - 1.0) : Chance of fruit spawning (Default: 0.1)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FruitRadius.1": (1 - X) : Radius in which fruit can spawn (Default: 2)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FruitMax.1": (1 - X) :  Number of rolls per day  (Default: 2)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FruitSeason.1": (e.g. "spring") : Season the fruit spawns (Default: "spring")

Death radius
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.DeathChance" (0.0 - 1.0) :Chance of crops, weeds and (young) trees dying if randomly
chosen (Required)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.DeathRadius": (1 - X) : Radius in which plants are at risk  (Default: 2)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.KillsCrops": (true, false) : If the death chance includes crops  (Default: true)

﻿Dry radius (does not include paddy crops)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.DryChance" (0.0 - 1.0) :Chance of hoed dirt being dried out if retaining soil applied (Required)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.DryRadius": (1 - X) : Radius in which dirt is at risk  (Default: 2)

Fertilizer
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FertilizerId": (e.g. "368") : The fertilizer used (Default "368")
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FertilizerChance" (0.0 - 1.0) :Chance of hoed dirt being fertilized (Required)
"MoorTarPetal.WildTreeFramework.FertilizerRadius": (1 - X) : Radius in which hoed dirt has a chance of being fertilized 
(Default: 2)
